decls.name: GolodShafarevichInfinite

paper_span.quote: Equivalently, a nontrivial finitely generated pro-\(p\) group with \(r\le d^2/4\) is infinite.

decls.rationale: The contrapositive form of Proposition 3.4 actually used in the construction: a nontrivial finitely generated pro-p group with \(r(G) \le d(G)^2/4\) is infinite.
